DEFENDANT PG&E COMPANY IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY JON DAILEY, SR. CLAIMS INVESTIGATOR. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-11-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ARPAJIAN, KIRSTEN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PACIFIC GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY $7,325.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,415.00, PLAINTIFF'S TESTIMONY THAT PG&E REPEATEDLY GAVE HER INCORRECT INFORMATION ABOUT HOW TO RESTORE SERVICE IS UNREBUTTED. THE COURT FINDS NEGLIGENCE AND AWARDS DAMAGES: LOSS OF RENT ($4,000.00), ECONOMIC DAMAGES ($2300 LANDSCAPER QUOTE, $900 PROPERTY MANAGER, $125 HUNT DRILLING, LESS OFFSET FOR WORK ON AGRICULTURAL WELL) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
